title: Physics-R1：用于视觉物理推理的经审计的奥林匹克竞赛语料库与配方
summary: 本文审计了多模态物理评估流程，发现训练-测试污染、翻译漂移和选择题饱和三大问题。发布了经审计的语料库PhysCorp-A、闭式强化学习池PhysR1Corp、全新来源的奥林匹克评估集PhysOlym-A，以及基于Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking冷启动的参考配方Physics-R1。实验表明，Physics-R1在多个基准上显著提升性能，部分指标超越更大模型。
summary_en: This paper audits the multimodal physics evaluation pipeline, uncovering train-test contamination, translation drift, and MCQ saturation. It releases an audited corpus (PhysCorp-A), a closed-form RL pool (PhysR1Corp), a novel-source olympiad eval (PhysOlym-A), and a reference recipe (Physics-R1) cold-started from Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking. Physics-R1 significantly improves performance across benchmarks, sometimes surpassing larger models.
